digest.component_or_area: outbound type mapping and configuration layer
propositions: Type mapping must be config-driven with per-project type_map axis supporting SKIP sentinel, mirroring S2 status_map pattern
Fail-closed validation fires once up-front in compute_outbound_mutations before mutation loop, asserting every syncable type is decided (mapped or SKIPped)
Per-project excluded sync types are EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES union {types mapped to SKIP}, replacing single hard-coded EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES at both consumers (differ loop and absent-gets)
rebar-type: annotation label must be stamped symmetrically with rebar-status: when local type lossy-collapses to Jira type, and recovered inbound reverse-map-free
type_map parameter threads through all three OutboundMapper implementations (Protocol, Cloud, Datacenter) and both field mappers (Cloud, DC) to resolve issuetype, replacing coerce defaults
rebar-type: prefix added to all four exclusion tuples (outbound_labels, inbound_collection_diffs, differ, inbound_translate) to prevent syncing as user tags
